content.text: Applicant Portal | Office of Undergraduate Admissions | UCI Apply your passions at UC Irvine Take the first steps on your Anteater journey. UC Irvine Applicant Portal There’s no other school that offers you as many opportunities for learning and professional experience like UC Irvine. Take the first steps on your Anteater journey. Log into your UC Irvine Applicant Portal to verify your information and ensure your checklist is complete. To log into your UC Irvine Applicant Portal, you must activate your UCInetID. Your UCInetID is your key to many online services at UC Irvine. Log into Your Applicant Portal Your application toolbox You have important resources to help you stay on top of the admission process, deadlines, and fees. Applicant Portal The Applicant Portal is your admissions hub. This is where you'll see updates to your application status, accept your offer of admission, communicate with your admissions counselor, and find your checklist of important tasks before becoming an enrolled student. ZotAid After you're admitted, ZotAid gives you access to your UC Irvine financial aid information, including important due dates, your financial aid status, required documents, and more. ZotAid is also your last step in completing your FAFSA award eligibility. Visit ZotAid
